agents_heartbeat_check.name: agents_heartbeat_check
agents_heartbeat_check.value:
"agents"."heartbeat_enabled" = ("agents"."heartbeat_next_at" is not null)
        and "agents"."heartbeat_interval_minutes" between 1 and 10080
        and "agents"."heartbeat_default_minutes" between 1 and 10080

inbox_states_source_check.name: inbox_states_source_check
inbox_states_source_check.value:
num_nonnulls("inbox_states"."approval_id", "inbox_states"."result_submission_id", "inbox_states"."run_id") = 1
        and (("inbox_states"."kind" = 'approval' and "inbox_states"."approval_id" is not null)
          or ("inbox_states"."kind" = 'result_submission' and "inbox_states"."result_submission_id" is not null)
          or ("inbox_states"."kind" = 'run_failure' and "inbox_states"."run_id" is not null))

instruction_revisions_editor_check.name: instruction_revisions_editor_check
instruction_revisions_editor_check.value:
("instruction_revisions"."editor_author" in ('copy', 'owner') and "instruction_revisions"."editor_agent_id" is null and "instruction_revisions"."editor_run_id" is null)
      or ("instruction_revisions"."editor_author" = 'agent' and "instruction_revisions"."editor_agent_id" is not null and "instruction_revisions"."editor_run_id" is not null)

messages_origin_check.name: messages_origin_check
messages_origin_check.value:
("messages"."author" = 'owner' and "messages"."delivery" is not null and "messages"."sent_by_run_id" is null)
        or ("messages"."author" = 'agent' and "messages"."delivery" is null and "messages"."sent_by_run_id" is not null)

notification_outbox_claim_check.name: notification_outbox_claim_check
notification_outbox_claim_check.value:
("notification_outbox"."claim_token" is null) = ("notification_outbox"."claim_expires_at" is null)
        and ("notification_outbox"."sent_at" is null or "notification_outbox"."claim_token" is null)

organizations_paused_from_check.name: organizations_paused_from_check
organizations_paused_from_check.value:
("organizations"."stage" = 'paused') = ("organizations"."paused_from" is not null)
        and "organizations"."paused_from" not in ('paused', 'completed', 'stopped')

organizations_goal_check.name: organizations_goal_check
organizations_goal_check.value: "organizations"."completion_criteria" is null or "organizations"."goal" is not null

research_links_author_check.name: research_links_author_check
research_links_author_check.value:
("research_links"."created_by_author" = 'owner' and "research_links"."created_by_agent_id" is null and "research_links"."created_by_run_id" is null)
      or ("research_links"."created_by_author" = 'agent' and "research_links"."created_by_agent_id" is not null and "research_links"."created_by_run_id" is not null)

research_map_edits_editor_check.name: research_map_edits_editor_check
research_map_edits_editor_check.value:
("research_map_edits"."editor_author" = 'owner' and "research_map_edits"."editor_agent_id" is null and "research_map_edits"."editor_run_id" is null)
      or ("research_map_edits"."editor_author" = 'agent' and "research_map_edits"."editor_agent_id" is not null and "research_map_edits"."editor_run_id" is not null)

research_nodes_status_check.name: research_nodes_status_check
research_nodes_status_check.value:
"research_nodes"."status" in ('proposed', 'in_progress', 'done', 'rejected', 'discarded')
        and ("research_nodes"."status_before_discard" is null or "research_nodes"."status_before_discard" in ('proposed', 'in_progress', 'done', 'rejected'))
        and ("research_nodes"."status" = 'discarded') = ("research_nodes"."status_before_discard" is not null)

research_nodes_author_check.name: research_nodes_author_check
research_nodes_author_check.value:
("research_nodes"."created_by_author" = 'owner' and "research_nodes"."created_by_agent_id" is null and "research_nodes"."created_by_run_id" is null)
      or ("research_nodes"."created_by_author" = 'agent' and "research_nodes"."created_by_agent_id" is not null and "research_nodes"."created_by_run_id" is not null)

runs_cancel_reason_check.name: runs_cancel_reason_check
runs_cancel_reason_check.value:
"runs"."cancel_reason" in ('organization_paused', 'organization_stopped', 'agent_paused', 'owner_interrupt')
        and ("runs"."cancel_reason" is null or "runs"."status" in ('running', 'cancelled'))

task_comments_author_check.name: task_comments_author_check
task_comments_author_check.value:
("task_comments"."author" = 'owner' and "task_comments"."agent_id" is null and "task_comments"."run_id" is null)
        or ("task_comments"."author" = 'agent' and "task_comments"."agent_id" is not null and "task_comments"."run_id" is not null)

tasks_report_check.name: tasks_report_check
tasks_report_check.value:
("tasks"."status" = 'completed') = ("tasks"."completed_at" is not null)
        and num_nulls("tasks"."completed_at", "tasks"."report_summary", "tasks"."completed_by_agent_id", "tasks"."completed_by_run_id") in (0, 4)

tasks_started_check.name: tasks_started_check
tasks_started_check.value:
("tasks"."status" <> 'open' or "tasks"."started_at" is null)
        and ("tasks"."status" <> 'in_progress' or "tasks"."started_at" is not null)

wakes_source_check.name: wakes_source_check
wakes_source_check.value:
("wakes"."kind" in ('organization_created', 'heartbeat')
          and num_nonnulls("wakes"."message_id", "wakes"."approval_id", "wakes"."task_id", "wakes"."comment_id", "wakes"."agent_to_agent_message_id", "wakes"."map_edit_id", "wakes"."instruction_revision_id", "wakes"."result_submission_id") = 0)
        or num_nonnulls("wakes"."message_id", "wakes"."approval_id", "wakes"."task_id", "wakes"."comment_id", "wakes"."agent_to_agent_message_id", "wakes"."map_edit_id", "wakes"."instruction_revision_id", "wakes"."result_submission_id") = 1
        and (("kind" = 'owner_message' and "message_id" is not null) or ("kind" = 'approval_decision' and "approval_id" is not null) or ("kind" = 'task_assigned' and "task_id" is not null) or ("kind" = 'task_completed' and "task_id" is not null) or ("kind" = 'task_comment' and "comment_id" is not null) or ("kind" = 'agent_to_agent_message' and "agent_to_agent_message_id" is not null) or ("kind" = 'research_map_edit' and "map_edit_id" is not null) or ("kind" = 'instruction_edit' and "instruction_revision_id" is not null) or ("kind" = 'result_changes_requested' and "result_submission_id" is not null))
